title: 5G NR UE Experimental Current Consumption Data
description: Experimental dataset of 5G NR User Equipment (UE) current consumption measurements and network-measured Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) collected across twelve experiments under varying channel conditions (0–60 dB attenuation, RSRP from −63 to −122 dBm) in a controlled 5G NR Standalone (SA) laboratory testbed. The dataset supports research on UE-level energy consumption characterization and prediction in 5G NR networks. Accompanying thesis: M. F. Bhutta, 'Experimental Characterization and ML-Based Prediction of 5G UE Energy Consumption Under Varying Channel Conditions,' M.S. thesis, University of Oulu, May 2026.

creators.name: Bhutta, Muhammad Faran
